title: A Current for the Passage
author: Freya Thornbury
blurb: Felix Blackwood, a railroad engineer with a map of closed lines, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. Then a dying prospector trades a map for a promise — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must beat the salvage fleet to the wreck by six tides before the concession permits expire.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
